evidence: Multiply ax^2+bx+c=0 by 4a, add b^2 and complete the square: (2ax+b)^2=b^2-4ac. Take both square roots over the complex numbers and divide by 2a. For real coefficients the sign of the discriminant determines whether the roots are real.
